ChurchPresenter uses a private HTTPS certificate for secure communication. You need to install it once so your device trusts the connection.
On ChurchPresenter desktop: Settings → Server → press "Download Cert" to show the QR code.
Safari will ask to download a configuration profile. Tap Allow, then go to Settings → General → VPN & Device Management, tap ChurchPresenter and install.
Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust Settings → enable full trust for ChurchPresenter CA.
Chrome downloads the .crt file. Tap it from the Downloads notification, choose "CA Certificate" and give it a name like "ChurchPresenter".

Android may block the install if your browser isn't allowed to install files. Go to Settings → Apps → [your browser] → Install unknown apps, then enable "Allow from this source". Return here and tap the file again.
Compare this fingerprint with what ChurchPresenter desktop shows in Settings → Server → Certificate SHA-256. They must match.
Connect to the server first to see the fingerprint

ChurchPresenter Mobile connects to the ChurchPresenter desktop app on your local network. Scan the QR code from the desktop to configure the connection automatically.

In the desktop app go to Settings → Mobile → and press "Show QR Code". A QR code with the connection details will appear on screen.
Tap the button below to open the camera and scan the QR code shown on the desktop. The connection will be configured automatically.
